parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source assays, activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary. Join assays to activities on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614236', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
